sentence: So girls are happy to take a risk in order to get to school every day.
synonym: willing to face danger to attend school
synonymNote: 两者都表示女孩愿意冒险去上学，意思相同

distractors.word: afraid to go to school safely
distractors.note: 意思相反，表示害怕而非愿意冒险

distractors.word: forced to stay away from school
distractors.note: 表示被迫远离学校，意思完全不同

distractors.word: too scared to try going to school
distractors.note: 表示太害怕不敢去，与原意相反
